motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor through December 31, 2025
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to approve the appointment of Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor through December 31, 2025. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Susan Allen appointed as senior citizen advisor
motions.summary: The council appointed Susan Allen as a Senior Citizen Advisor, serving through December 31, 2025.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day — this fills a volunteer advisory seat through the end of the year.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to approve the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda approved
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, the batch of items voted through together without separate discussion.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — this is routine housekeeping, and the record of the motion does not list which items were in the batch.

motions.item_title: Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Alpine School District Elementary 133
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Alpine School District Elementary 133. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Land rezoned for the new elementary school
motions.summary: The council rezoned the land for Alpine School District's Elementary 133 so the school can be built there.
motions.impact: Paired with the site plan approval, this lets the school district move ahead. Neighbors will get a school on that land instead of whatever the previous zoning allowed.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt Alpine School District Elementary 133 Preliminary Plat and Site Plan. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: New Alpine School District elementary school approved
motions.summary: The council approved the preliminary plat and site plan for Alpine School District's Elementary 133.
motions.impact: If you live near the site, expect school construction and eventually the traffic a new elementary school brings. This approval clears the way for the district to build.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah approving the Culinary Water Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah approving the Culinary Water Master Plan and Impact Fee Facilities Plan (IFFP). Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Drinking water master plan and impact fee plan adopted
motions.summary: The city adopted its long-range plan for drinking water facilities along with the impact fee plan that sets what new construction pays toward them.
motions.impact: Nothing changes on your water bill today. The plan decides which water projects get built and is the basis for fees charged to new homes and buildings, not to existing ones.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the First Amendment to Master Development Agreement for Ault Farms (Parkway Fields)
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the First Amendment to Master Development Agreement for Ault Farms (Parkway Fields), including a nine-month sunset clause in the Amendment. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Changes to the Ault Farms (Parkway Fields) development deal
motions.summary: The council approved the first amendment to the Ault Farms (Parkway Fields) master development agreement, adding a nine-month sunset clause to the amendment.
motions.impact: This touches the Parkway Fields area rather than the city at large, and the amended terms expire after nine months. The motion itself does not say what else in the agreement changed.
